maya: Morning jam—bad joke brigade roll call. Bring your worst coffee pun. :coffee:
sam: I'm in. Espresso yourself. :joy:
devon: Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged. :laughing:
liam: That's criminally good. :police_car: My turn: I asked my coffee to tell a joke, it said "beans about you". :grimacing:
arjun: We should start a band: The Rolling Scones. (bad bakery puns are allowed?) :croissant:
maya: @liam solid. Also: I put decaf on the keyboard — now it's just a space bar. :keyboard:
sam: poll: which is worse? `mugged` vs `space bar` — react with :one: for mugged, :two: for space bar
devon: :one: mugged. also adding "latte to see you" to the canon.
liam: :two: space bar for the absurdity.
kudos-bot: 🎉 Kudos to @devon for making the break room laugh. +1
maya: Results so far: 1️⃣=1 2️⃣=1. Tie. Tiebreaker: worst pun wins.
arjun: worst pun: "I like my coffee like I like my coding errors: frequent and small." :sweat_smile:
sam: haha that one hurts. Winner by groan: @arjun
devon: I'll bring stickers tomorrow: "Bad joke brigade founding member" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
maya: Meeting adjourned. Don't forget pastries at 3 — real ones, not puns. :croissant:
